articles.title: Swiftlet: run 80B Qwen in ~4.3 GB RAM on a Mac, 35B on an iPhone (Apache 2.0) Swift + Metal runtime that…
articles.summary: Swiftlet is a Swift and Metal runtime that claims it can run an 80B Qwen model in about 4.3 GB of RAM on a Mac and a 35B model on an iPhone. It does this by keeping only a roughly 3B dense core in memory and streaming routed MoE experts from SSD when needed. The description says the 35B model runs at 7–11 tokens per second on an M5 Mac and about 1 token per second on an iPhone 17, and it also provides an OpenAI-compatible loopback server. For AI on-device, the key takeaway is that large-model behavior may be possible on consumer hardware, but with a clear speed and recall tradeoff.
